incidents.victim: Ahold Delhaize (Food Lion, Stop & Shop, Albert Heijn, Delhaize)
incidents.vector: Unknown initial access; company took systems offline proactively after discovering the incident Sunday, October 12.
incidents.impact: Distribution centers, online grocery ordering, and in-store pricing disrupted across US, Netherlands, and Belgium. 400,000+ employees and millions of customers affected; no data compromise confirmed.

incidents.victim: Foschini Group — Phase Eight, Hobbs, Whistles (UK retail)
incidents.vector: Unknown initial access; incident discovered Sunday and reported Monday to UK authorities with cybersecurity specialists engaged.
incidents.impact: IT systems at three UK fashion brands disrupted; stores remain open but multiple IT services offline. Payment data not confirmed compromised; personal data exposure under investigation.

incidents.victim: 70+ US technology and defense companies (North Korean IT worker scheme)
incidents.vector: North Korean nationals obtained remote employment at US firms using false identities, generating revenue for the regime while maintaining insider access to sensitive systems.
incidents.impact: At least 70 US companies infiltrated; significant revenue directed to North Korea's weapons programs and potential intellectual property exfiltration. DOJ announced charges and disruption actions October 13.

incidents.victim: Android phone buyers — Midnight Mimosa supply chain
incidents.vector: Malware pre-installed on cheap Android smartphones sold under flagship-mimicking names (S25 Ultra, i17 Pro); disables Google Play Store to evade detection.
incidents.impact: Affected devices include clickjacking, proxy botnet, and ad fraud capabilities. Broad consumer exposure; scale of deployment unknown. Discovered by Bitdefender.

incidents.victim: SkyNet internet provider (St. Petersburg, Russia)
incidents.vector: DDoS attacks combined with network intrusion; Ukrainian group BO Team claims to have disabled 15,000+ SkyNet network devices since October 6.
incidents.impact: Ongoing service disruptions for residential and business customers: internet outages, high latency, voice and video service failures. Retaliation for Russian drone strikes on Ukrainian data centers.

incidents.victim: RAF Fairford airbase (UK base used by US strategic bombers)
incidents.vector: UK government formally attributed a hybrid operation (cyber and physical elements) directed by the IRGC against RAF Fairford, used by US B-52 and B-2 strategic aircraft.
incidents.impact: UK Prime Minister issued formal attribution; Iranian ambassador summoned. Over 20 allied nations issued a joint condemnation statement. UK-US relationship around the base highlighted as a strategic target.

incidents.victim: Organizations using Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect / Prisma Access
incidents.vector: Authentication bypass in PAN-OS GlobalProtect and Prisma Access (CVE-2026-0257) exploited to open unauthorized VPN sessions for ransomware initial access.
incidents.impact: Actively exploited in the wild as of October 12 by ransomware actors; organizations relying on affected Palo Alto VPN products face immediate compromise risk pending patching.

incidents.victim: ccTLD registries (.as American Samoa, .gh Ghana, .sl Sierra Leone)
incidents.vector: DNS record manipulation enabling attackers to pass domain ownership verification checks and obtain fraudulent HTTPS certificates for targeted domains.
incidents.impact: Three country-code top-level domain namespaces compromised; Google services and other organizations targeted via fraudulent certificates. Full scope of exploitation unclear.

incidents.victim: ASOS (UK online fashion retailer)
incidents.vector: Attacker impersonated a trusted contact to compromise an employee account, then used it to send a mass unauthorized push notification to ASOS's entire customer base.
incidents.impact: Unauthorized mass push notifications sent to ASOS customers announcing the breach; reputational damage and phishing exposure for millions of customers.

incidents.victim: French supermarkets — Intermarché, Netto, Coopérative U (~400 stores)
incidents.vector: Remote exploitation of vulnerabilities in Danfoss refrigeration controllers (older software versions) to trigger defrost cycle, spoiling perishable inventory.
incidents.impact: Fresh food spoiled across approximately 400 supermarkets nationwide; French cybersecurity agency ANSSI mobilized at national and EU level. CEO called it "unprecedented" and "unacceptable" targeting of food supply infrastructure.

incidents.victim: Yandex data centers (Russia — three hubs struck in four days)
incidents.attacker: Ukraine — state cyber and kinetic operations
incidents.vector: Ukrainian drone strikes on physical data center infrastructure; third strike in four days targeting Yandex facilities near Moscow.
incidents.impact: 80 Yandex cloud services disrupted; Cloudflare reported 50% drop in Russian automated bot traffic. Retaliation for Russian strikes on Ukrainian data centers in the same period.

incidents.victim: Organizations using SonicWall SMA 1000 enterprise VPN
incidents.vector: Server-side request forgery via CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS 10.0) in SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances; allows unauthenticated access to internal network resources.
incidents.impact: Actively exploited since October 9; all organizations with internet-exposed SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances face immediate compromise risk. Critical severity rated by vendor.

incidents.victim: US and global critical infrastructure (government, manufacturing, healthcare, IT, telecom)
incidents.attacker: China — state-suspected espionage group (enabled by Integrity Technology Group)
incidents.vector: Integrity Technology Group, a Chinese government-linked commercial cyber enabler, provided attack infrastructure and tooling that supported intrusions by multiple state-sponsored threat clusters targeting critical infrastructure globally.
incidents.impact: Widespread persistent access across US and allied-nation critical infrastructure. Joint advisory AA26-281A issued by CISA, NSA, FBI, and allied agencies from Australia, UK, and Canada. Sectors include government, manufacturing, healthcare, IT, and telecommunications.

incidents.victim: South Korean banks and financial companies
incidents.vector: AI-augmented attacks using ARTEX (Chinese-developed open-source penetration testing tool) and AI agents to conduct automated intrusions; campaign confirmed by CrowdStrike.
incidents.impact: Confirmed data exfiltration from multiple South Korean financial institutions; South Korean authorities investigating. First confirmed operational deployment of AI-augmented intrusion tooling at scale.

incidents.victim: Taiwan research organizations
incidents.vector: Adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) phishing campaign targeting Taiwan research organizations with credential harvesting and persistent access establishment.
incidents.impact: Ongoing intrusions across Taiwanese research institutions; espionage operation targeting sensitive research data and intellectual property.

incidents.victim: Oracle Health / Cerner legacy systems (20 million patients)
incidents.vector: Intrusion into Oracle Health's legacy Cerner electronic health record systems; Oracle delayed public disclosure by approximately one year.
incidents.impact: Personal health records of 20 million patients compromised. Oracle acknowledged the breach after prolonged concealment, drawing significant regulatory and legal exposure.

incidents.victim: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway (50,000+ exposed instances)
incidents.vector: Mass exploitation of two zero-day vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772) in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway; active since August 21.
incidents.impact: Over 50,000 instances remain exposed; ongoing exploitation across enterprise, healthcare, and government sectors. Joint advisory issued by Citrix and allied agencies.

incidents.victim: IDC Frontier Cloud (Japanese government cloud provider)
incidents.vector: Ransomware attack against cloud server infrastructure supporting Japanese government customers.
incidents.impact: Server infrastructure disrupted across IDC Frontier Cloud; Japanese government-hosted services affected. Full scope of data exposure and recovery timeline under investigation.

incidents.victim: Water utilities, telecom, government, and universities in Spain and Portugal
incidents.vector: Warlock ransomware targeting Spanish and Portuguese-language organizations with known capability to reach operational technology (OT) networks.
incidents.impact: Ongoing campaign across water utilities, telecommunications providers, government agencies, and universities in Spain and Portugal; OT network disruption capability confirmed.

incidents.victim: South Africa Air Traffic and Navigation Services (ATNS)
incidents.vector: Ransomware that propagated from IT networks into operational technology (OT) systems controlling air traffic management.
incidents.impact: OT network compromise at South Africa's air traffic control authority; aviation safety risk narrowly avoided. Attack could have crippled air traffic operations across the country.

incidents.victim: Open-source ecosystems — npm, Go, and Rust package registries
incidents.vector: Malicious packages published to npm (including Axios and Mastra AI), Go, and Rust (arrayref) registries with embedded backdoors; documentation crafted specifically to deceive AI coding assistants.
incidents.impact: Ongoing poisoning of widely used open-source package ecosystems; developers and AI coding agents using affected packages risk backdoor installation and credential theft. PromptMink campaign confirmed by multiple vendors.

incidents.victim: DIVD — Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure
incidents.vector: AI-driven attack against DIVD's internal systems; technique and initial access vector under investigation by the organization.
incidents.impact: Breach of a trusted cybersecurity research organization; potential exposure of sensitive vulnerability disclosure data and researcher communications.

incidents.victim: Government and policy organizations (Taiwan, India, Philippines, Cambodia)
incidents.vector: Targeted intrusion campaign using custom tooling against government and policy organizations across multiple Asian nations.
incidents.impact: Persistent access established across multiple Asian government targets; ongoing espionage operation targeting policy-sensitive information in the Indo-Pacific region.

incidents.victim: Danish central population register (8.8 million citizens)
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access via a compromised account protected by a weak password; attacker exfiltrated data on both living and deceased Danish citizens.
incidents.impact: Names, addresses, and social security numbers of 8.8 million Danish citizens stolen — effectively the entire national population. Denmark's Ministry of Research, Education and Digitalisation confirmed the breach.

incidents.victim: Oracle PeopleSoft users — FBI, government, education, healthcare (dozens of orgs)
incidents.vector: Mass automated exploitation of CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft across dozens of organizations; attackers targeted unpatched internet-exposed instances.
incidents.impact: 5,000+ FBI special agent personnel records stolen; FBI terminated contractor Accenture for failure to patch. Dozens of organizations across government, education, and healthcare compromised. Suspects arrested in US and Jordan.

incidents.victim: US Defense Manpower Data Center — 3 million military personnel records
incidents.vector: Unauthorized persistent access maintained for approximately 9 months before detection; specific initial access vector not publicly disclosed.
incidents.impact: Personal and service records of approximately 3 million US active duty, reserve, and veteran personnel exfiltrated; one of the largest known breaches of US military personnel data.

incidents.victim: US financial services firm (unnamed)
incidents.vector: ClickFix social engineering via fake browser verification pages delivering GeniexRAT through victim-executed copy-paste commands; targeted financial sector employees.
incidents.impact: Malware installed with credential harvesting and remote access capability at an unnamed US financial institution; part of a broader North Korean ClickFix campaign confirmed by CrowdStrike.

incidents.victim: Ukrainian government-linked entities and diaspora employees (France, US, Canada)
incidents.vector: ClickFix campaign using fake CAPTCHA pages to deliver GammaLoad malware via copy-paste command execution; targeted Ukrainian government affiliates and diaspora workers in Western countries.
incidents.impact: Credential harvesting and persistent access to Ukrainian government-linked networks and diaspora organizations; ongoing intelligence collection operation against Ukrainian interests abroad.

incidents.victim: iRhythm — 360,000+ cardiac monitoring patients
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to iRhythm systems containing patient health and device data; specific attack vector not disclosed.
incidents.impact: Personal health data of more than 360,000 patients with cardiac monitoring devices stolen; affected patients notified under HIPAA breach notification requirements.

incidents.victim: Iraqi critical infrastructure (telecommunications and aviation)
incidents.vector: Blinder Tunnel campaign using encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS tunneling to establish covert C2 channels within Iraqi telecom and aviation networks; operated March through June 2026.
incidents.impact: Persistent access to Iraqi critical infrastructure sectors for intelligence collection and strategic pre-positioning. Campaign assessed complete but knowledge of network architecture retained by Iran.
